name: Remove Duplicates
label: Unique rows
description: In-process unique-by-keys. unique_history is per-environment and bounded (shared store, not JVM memory).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Remove Duplicates operation. Set operation (or rely on config). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'unique'.

schema.label: keys
schema.description: Optional JSON array of field paths on object items (e.g. ["id","email"]). Ignored for scalars. Dedup is case-sensitive and keeps first occurrence order.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: unique | unique_history. Required. Example: 'unique'.

configurationParameters.label: Keys
configurationParameters.description: JSON array of identity field paths on object items. Example: '["email"]'. Ignored when items are not objects.

configurationParameters.label: History Scope
configurationParameters.description: Per-env history key suffix. Bounded. Example: 'leads'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
